title: Uvas Canyon Park
description: A late-spring weekend at Uvas Canyon Park, one of South Bay’s hidden gems. Three days of rain had refreshed the trail, and the canyon felt alive with emerald moss, flowing water, and a soft misty light. We arrived around 11:30 AM on a cloudy, gentle-drizzle morning that never quite soaked us. The one-mile waterfall loop is slightly steep in places, but every turn rewarded us with small cascades, stream-side rocks, and the magical sound of water moving through the forest.
